title.zh: 综合项目 · 两张照片的巡检报告

brief.zh: 用同一组照片从 OpenCV 预处理做到 YOLOX 检测。对照原图、中间结果和最后的检测框，交出一份可核对的巡检报告。
brief.en: Take the same pair of photos from OpenCV preprocessing through YOLOX detection. Compare the originals, the intermediate images, and the final boxes to make an inspection report.

concept.zh: OpenCV 输出的图像会直接送给 YOLOX。预处理和置信度门槛都可能影响检测结果。
concept.en: The images produced by OpenCV go directly into YOLOX. Both preprocessing and the confidence threshold can affect the detections.

hints.zh: 先把两张照片统一变亮，并把较长的一边缩放到 480 像素。运行预处理后再试检测。
hints.en: Brighten both photos and scale the longer edge to 480 pixels. Run preprocessing before trying detection.

hints.zh: 核对原图里的狗和人。如果某张照片没有框，试着降低门槛，再看分数和框的位置。
hints.en: Look for the dog and the person in the originals. If one photo has no box, lower the threshold, then check the scores and positions.

prompt.zh: 对两张照片使用“提亮”和长边 480 像素。调整检测门槛，让拉布拉多犬和宇航员各有一个正确的框。
prompt.en: Brighten both photos and set their long edges to 480 pixels. Adjust the detection threshold until the Labrador and the astronaut each have one correct box.
